title: How Effectively Can BERT Models Interpret Context and Detect Bengali Communal Violent Text?

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying Bengali social media text into a 'Religio Communal' violence category using fine-tuned BERT models, and utilizing LIME (Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations) to analyze the models' sensitivity and feature attribution regarding specific religious terms (e.g., Muslim, Hindu, Islam, Allah).

Evaluating fine-tuned and ensemble BERT models on their ability to detect 'Ethno Communal' violence (directed at individuals based on ethnic identity, such as the Rohingya) in Bengali text, utilizing data augmentation techniques to address class imbalance.

Measuring model performance in identifying 'Nondenominational' communal violence, which the paper defines as targeting individuals based on linguistic identity, geographical differences, and cultural differences.
